Method of Attack: Downloader functionality using email communication to receive instructions from command and control (C2) server
Uses Word documents with remote templates embedded with malicious macro code
Macro uses AutoClose function to delay execution until document is closed
Adds persistence, creates unique system identifier, collects system details, takes desktop snapshots
Logs into POP3 email accounts to access attachments
Sends system data and screenshots via multiple email accounts to threat actors
Obtains payload from emails sent by threat actors
Impacted Systems: Government organizations in North America, Europe, and a former Soviet state
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing via Word documents with malicious macros
Indicators of Compromise: Emails sent via accounts hosted at Czech service provider Seznam
Weaponized file named 'crash list (Lion Air Boeing 737).docx'
